summary: App with signup flow (including an access code step); next planned work is tightening backend rules.

new_feature_requests.summary: Tighten backend rules (security/authorization) after the new access-code signup step

Require that the caller has an existing user profile (not just an AccessControl #user permission) to use user/report endpoints: getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile, createReport, listReports, and getReportById. If the profile does not exist, reject the call with a clear trap message instructing the user to sign up first.

Harden signup and report creation against client-supplied privileged fields by enforcing server authority: during signupWithCode, ignore any incoming profile.role value and always store role = #engineer for new signups; during createReport, ignore any incoming report.createdBy value and always store createdBy = caller (current behavior) and ensure this is the only persisted creator value.

Prevent report overwrites by enforcing report ID uniqueness in createReport: if a report with the same id already exists, reject the call with a clear trap message rather than overwriting the existing report.
When an admin deletes a user via deleteUser, also remove/revoke that user's authorization role(s) in AccessControl so the deleted principal cannot continue to pass permission checks after deletion.

projectName: Tighten backend authorization and data integrity rules
